crossRefs.note: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die.…
For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the…
Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not…
but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

translations.web: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.
translations.bsb: No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.
translations.kjv: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
translations.asv: Neither shall any of the priests drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
